verdict.rationale: Raygun's docs list 'Sending dSYMS to Raygun' and 'Uploading ProGuard mapping files' as services that use the external access token. That shows first-party upload paths for iOS and Android symbol files, but only as a passing mention. Nothing in the pack covers native debug symbols or describes the resulting symbolication to function names and line numbers. Missing for 10: native debug symbol (e.g. NDK/Breakpad/PDB) upload support, in-depth dSYM/ProGuard symbolication docs showing function and line resolution, independent or hands-on corroboration.
